description: All the dates in a year for one BEA release, such as every 2027 GDP or PCE date. Reads the US Bureau of Economic Analysis release dates file and returns each scheduled date for the named release with times in Eastern, UTC and your time zone. Accepts short names (gdp, pce, trade, corporate_profits, international_transactions, state_gdp) or a full BEA release name. For planners and analysts building a year's calendar. Dates BEA has not yet scheduled are not shown, and the file does not say which period each date covers. (cost: 1 credit)

release.description: string, required, short name (gdp, pce, trade, corporate_profits, international_transactions, state_gdp) or a BEA release name such as "Gross Domestic Product"

timezone.description: string, optional, IANA time zone for the local time fields (e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Tokyo), default Europe/London

year.description: integer, optional, calendar year 2020-2035, default the current year

name: bea_release_dates_for_year
